title: Problem Areas in Diabetes (PAID) Assessment for Emotional Distress
implementation_guidance: Administer the Problem Areas in Diabetes (PAID) scale to assess diabetes-related emotional distress. This 20-item questionnaire helps identify specific areas of diabetes management causing emotional burden. Use results to: identify patients with high distress scores (>40), target specific areas of diabetes management causing the most distress, track changes in emotional distress over time, and guide conversations about emotional aspects of diabetes management.
expected_outcomes: Improved identification of diabetes-related emotional distress, better targeting of psychological support, reduced depression symptoms, enhanced patient-provider communication about emotional aspects of diabetes, improved quality of life, and better glycemic control through addressing emotional barriers.
target_population: Medicaid-enrolled individuals with type 2 diabetes, particularly those showing signs of diabetes distress or depression.
citation: Stuckey HL, Dellasega C, Graber NJ, Mauger DT, Lendel I, Gabbay RA. Diabetes Nurse Case Management and Motivational Interviewing for Change (DYNAMIC): Study Design and Baseline Characteristics in the Chronic Care Model for Type 2 Diabetes. Contemp Clin Trials. 2009;30(4):366-374. doi:10.1016/j.cct.2009.03.002.
